hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.rs) dir=$(dirname "$f"); while [ "$dir" != "/" ] && [ ! -f "$dir/Cargo.toml" ]; do dir=$(dirname "$dir"); done; if [ -f "$dir/Cargo.toml" ]; then cd "$dir" && cargo fmt --all 2>/dev/null; fi; echo '{"suppressOutput":true}' ;; *) echo '{}' ;; esac; }
